title: feat(plugin-form,spec)!: ObjectForm lays the form out, the object-form block opens drawer/modal, split retires
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8CqY3XxuBymEc8yx73EJkMq)_
Fixes #27159

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: narrowed (the `object-form` block's `formType` refuses `split`; its `splitDirection`, `splitSize`, `splitResizable` and `sections[].pane`, the `object-master-detail-form` block's `sections[].pane`, and `FormViewSchema.splitDirection`, are tombstones)
Skills-docs: `skills/objectstack-ui/references/react-blocks.md` regenerated by `gen:react-blocks` (the React `ObjectForm` contract drops `split` and `splitDirection`); no hand edit under `skills/**`

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：`ObjectForm` 只负责表单布局（simple / tabbed / wizard），抽屉和弹窗由新的 `ObjectFormContainer` 承接，`object-form` 区块渲染器在 `formType` 为 drawer / modal 时走它；`formType: 'split'`、`SplitForm` 以及 split 专用键全部退役。
- 为什么改：ADR-0050（裁定 6464210455，A′）规定布局与容器分离，#27155 已收窄表单视图的 `type`，本卡是渲染器这一半。
- 风险与回滚：区块的 drawer / modal 行为不变（同一段代码搬家）；直接挂载 `ObjectForm` 并写 `formType: "drawer"` 的宿主现在得到内联表单。回滚即还原本 PR，18.3.0 尚未发布，转换器和 tombstone 一起撤回即可。
- 先看：`ui/packages/plugin-form/src/ObjectFormContainer.tsx`、`index.tsx` 的区块分流、`packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts` 的 tombstone、`conversions/registry.ts` 新增的 `convertBlock`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-form/src/__tests__/objectFormContainer-27159.test.tsx`，再跑 `cd packages/spec && npx vitest run src/ui/form-view-type-layout-retirement.test.ts`。
- 需要你做的：等合同复核 PASS 与座位 ACCEPT 后再审批；#27153 上的 drawerSide / drawerWidth 结论见下文 Acceptance notes。

## What changes

ADR-0050 Decision 4, the renderer half of #27155: a form's `formType` is its layout, and the container belongs to the caller. On the `object-form` block, the block itself is that caller.

- **`@object-ui/plugin-form`.** `ObjectForm` drops its `split`, `drawer` and `modal` arms and keeps the three layouts (and master-detail routing). The drawer and modal arms move unchanged into the new `ObjectFormContainer.tsx`, which shares `ObjectForm`'s schema preparation through the extracted `usePreparedFormSchema` hook. The registered `object-form` renderer sends `formType: 'drawer' | 'modal'` to `ObjectFormContainer` and everything else to `ObjectForm`. `SplitForm.tsx` is deleted and `SplitForm` / `SplitFormProps` / `SplitFormSchema` leave the exports. The block's published inputs drop `split` and the three split keys. The section `pane` reader (`SECTION_LAYOUT_KEYS`) goes, and the `#6237` diagnostic's remedy no longer names `split`.
- **`@objectstack/spec`.** The `object-form` block's `formType` is `enumWithRetiredValues(['simple','tabbed','wizard','drawer','modal'], …)`, so `split` is refused by name with a prescription. `splitDirection`, `splitSize`, `splitResizable` and the block section's `pane` are `retiredKey()` tombstones, and so is `FormViewSchema.splitDirection`, which lost its last reader with `SplitForm`. The React contract (`react-blocks.ts`) drops `split` and `splitDirection`. The `.describe()` strings of `drawerSide`, `drawerWidth`, `modalSize` and `modalCloseButton` now name the block's drawer and modal containers.
- **Retirement kit, absorbed into #27155's entry.** `@objectstack/spec` is 18.2.0 on `main`, so 18.3.0 is unreleased and the skill's same-major rule puts this in the existing D2 conversion `form-view-presentation-types-removed`. It now strips `splitDirection` from every form payload and has a new `convertBlock` over `object-form` page blocks (regions, slots and container nesting): it deletes `formType: 'split'`, strips the three keys and every section `pane`, and leaves `drawer` / `modal` alone. The D3 entry `ui-form-view-type-layout-only` is widened to match. Four new `RETIRED_KEYS_BY_MAJOR` entry files cover `ui/FormView:splitDirection` and `ui/ObjectFormProps:{splitDirection,splitSize,splitResizable}`. Also updated: the liveness rows (`splitDirection` is now `dead`/REMOVED; the `drawerSide` / `drawerWidth` notes cite the container), the removal-version pins, and the regenerated references, authorable surface and state counts.
- **`@object-ui/types`.** `ObjectFormSchema.formType` drops `split`. The three split keys stay declared, but as the spec's tombstones by reference (the `defaultFilters` precedent), so the parity census still pairs them. The section `pane` member is removed.
- **Console and Studio.** The page-block inspector no longer offers `Split` (`block-config.ts`, and the studio string `engine.inspector.pageBlock.option.formType.split` is removed from en and zh). `form-preview.ts` and `RecordFormPage.tsx` drop the dead `'split'` literals and the split keys. `FormPage.tsx`'s `FORM_SPEC_TYPES` is the three layouts.
- **Docs.** The plugin-form README and `plugin-form.mdx` lose the SplitForm and `pane` passages and gain "Where an `object-form` block opens". `schema-reference.md` no longer says the block's `formType` aligns with `FormViewSchema.type`. The #27155 changeset is left as written (a changeset on the base cannot change); this PR's changeset carries the BREAKING FROM → TO and a "Supersedes" bullet correcting #27155's `splitDirection` line. The `object-master-detail-form` block's `sections[].pane` is tombstoned too (the shared section shape) and the D2 conversion strips it there (contract review 6485040701, should-fix 1).

## Tests

- New: `ui/packages/plugin-form/src/__tests__/objectFormContainer-27159.test.tsx`. Through `SchemaRenderer`, a `drawer` / `modal` block opens a dialog that holds the form, and a `tabbed` block renders inline. A `drawer` / `modal` node handed straight to `ObjectForm` renders inline, so the container is the caller's (this fails on `main`, where `ObjectForm` opened the drawer). The #1890 pin: a tabbed layout inside the modal container still draws its tabs. CONTROL: a layout handed to the container falls back to the inline form.
- Spec: `form-view-type-layout-retirement.test.ts` gains an `object-form` block describe. It pins the vocabulary, the `split` refusal with prescription, a CONTROL that `drawer` / `modal` parse with their keys, the three key tombstones on every `formType`, the section `pane` tombstone, the `RETIRED_KEYS_BY_MAJOR` rows, a tsc pin and a stored-page conversion. The tree walk now also judges any `formType: 'split'`. `splitDirection` joins the form-view tombstone rows and the stored-view conversion pin.
- About 20 plugin-form suites that mounted `drawer` / `modal` through `ObjectForm` now mount `ObjectFormContainer`, the block's own route. Split rows are removed from every arms/layout matrix. The `sectionFaultCarry` site census moves 5 → 2 + 2.

## Acceptance notes

- **On #27153.** Measured: `drawerSide` and `drawerWidth` keep a live reader. The `object-form` block's drawer container reaches `DrawerForm` (`ObjectFormContainer.tsx` → `DrawerForm.tsx`, which reads `drawerSide` and `drawerWidth`). So neither key is retired here, and the enforce-or-remove question for form views stays open on #27153. `modalSize` is also read by the console's record dialog on every layout.
- Premise partly disproved and resolved with the seat: `AppContent.tsx` and `useActionModal.tsx` already mount `ModalForm` directly, so they needed no change.
- Not in this PR (outside the claimed paths, comment-only): `SplitForm` mentions in `ui/packages/types/src/data.ts`, `packages/metadata-core/src/form-predicate-root-policy.ts`, `content/docs/protocol/objectui/layout-dsl.mdx` and `ui/packages/app-shell/README.md`. The `object-master-detail-form` prescriptions for `drawer` / `modal` still say "portal dialog".

## Verification

All runs below are local, on this branch. The spec and ui suites and dogfood ran on the merged head `6f5071c3`, with 22 commits of `main` merged and the reference docs regenerated.

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived 122 commands, and all 122 exit 0. `--ran` reconciles 122 derived, 122 run, 0 unrun. Three of them first refused on a missing prerequisite and passed after it was provided: `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` needed the pinned fixture fetched (shallow clone), `check:skill-examples` needed a `client-react` build, and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` needed every dist. One gate found a real problem, `doc-version-claims`, because the docs named a version literal; the literal is removed.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test`: 749 files and 22377 tests pass. `check:generated` is current.
- ui vitest over plugin-form, types, i18n, the console FormPage suites, the app-shell previews and RecordFormPage: 883 files and 16460 tests pass (14 skipped).
- `type-check` passes for `@object-ui/plugin-form`, `types`, `app-shell`, `console` and `i18n`, and `pnpm --dir ui run type-check:scripts` passes.
- `node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs` passes after `gen-sdui-manifest-node.mjs` regenerated the manifest; the diff is the block's `formType` enum and the three removed inputs. `node scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs --changed-from origin/main` passes.
- Dogfood battery (`packages/qa/dogfood`, `pnpm test`) after rebuilding the closure: 348 files and 2806 tests pass. The CI Dogfood Regression Gate does not run on pull requests, so this local run is the evidence for that gate.
